title: Monkey Tail Cactus - 1x Mini Plug - Interesting Easy Care Trailing Cactus
description: The Monkey Tail Cactus is a unique and eye-catching trailing cactus that is perfect for indoor spaces. With its green colour and easy care requirements, it is an ideal choice for any room in your home. This mini plug plant thrives in full sun and needs light watering, making it a convenient addition to your garden or patio. Its running growth habit adds a touch of natural beauty to your living space, making it a popular choice among plant enthusiasts.
